data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Ratna refers to a jewel, a treasure, or a precious stone. It is believed that possessing a Ratna can bring wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. Ratna is also a name of a goddess, signifying beauty, grace, and purity. The name Ratna carries the meaning “Jewel, treasure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ratna usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel, treasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ratna total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
